240: function normalizeImageKey(value) {
241:     return String(value || '')
242:         .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
243:         .toLowerCase()
244:         .replace(/[’`]/g, "'")
245:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9']+/g, ' ')
246:         .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
247:         .trim();
248: }
249: 
250: function resolveImageUniverseKey(rawUniverse) {
251:     const raw = String(rawUniverse || '').trim();
252:     if (!raw) return null;
253:     if (FANDOM_WIKIS[raw]) return raw;
254:     const alias = FANDOM_UNIVERSE_ALIASES[normalizeImageKey(raw)];
255:     if (alias) return alias;
256:     // Les nouveaux anime n'ont pas tous un wiki Fandom configuré : on accepte
257:     // directement leur clé/nom ARC et resolveCharacterImage utilisera AniList.
258:     try {
259:         if (typeof ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME !== 'undefined') {
260:             if (ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[raw]) return raw;
261:             const wanted = normalizeImageKey(raw);
262:             const hit = Object.entries(ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME).find(([, label]) => normalizeImageKey(label) === wanted);
263:             if (hit) return hit[0];
264:         }
265:     } catch (_) {}
266:     return null;
267: }

269: function cleanImageCharacterName(name) {
270:     return String(name || '')
271:         .replace(/\s+\((?:adult|young|child|anime|manga|movie|film)\)\s*$/i, '')
272:         .trim();
273: }

275: function parseCharacterLabelForImage(label) {
276:     const s = String(label || '').trim();
277:     if (!s) return { name:'', universe:null };
278: 
279:     if (s.endsWith(')')) {
280:         const i = s.lastIndexOf(' (');
281:         if (i > 0) {
282:             return {
283:                 name: s.slice(0, i).trim(),
284:                 universe: s.slice(i + 2, -1).trim()
285:             };
286:         }
287:     }
288:     return { name:s, universe:null };
289: }

291: async function getCachedCharacterImage(universeKey, displayName) {
292:     const normName = normalizeImageKey(displayName);
293:     const cacheKey = `${universeKey}|${normName}`;
294: 
295:     if (CHARACTER_IMAGE_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) {
296:         return CHARACTER_IMAGE_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
297:     }
298: 
299:     if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) return null;
300:     try {
301:         const result = await pool.query(
302:             `SELECT image_url, source_url, status
303:              FROM character_images
304:              WHERE universe_key=$1 AND norm_name=$2
305:              LIMIT 1`,
306:             [universeKey, normName]
307:         );
308:         if (!result.rows.length) return null;
309:         const row = result.rows[0];
310:         const data = {
311:             imageUrl: row.image_url || null,
312:             sourceUrl: row.source_url || null,
313:             status: row.status || 'missing'
314:         };
315:         CHARACTER_IMAGE_CACHE.set(cacheKey, data);
316:         return data;
317:     } catch (e) {
318:         return null;
319:     }
320: }

323:     const normName = normalizeImageKey(displayName);
324:     const cacheKey = `${universeKey}|${normName}`;
325:     CHARACTER_IMAGE_CACHE.set(cacheKey, data);

346:             data.status || 'missing'

353: function pageImageFromApiPage(page) {
354:     if (!page || page.missing != null) return null;
355:     const imageUrl = page.original?.source || page.thumbnail?.source || null;
356:     if (!imageUrl) return null;
357:     return {
358:         imageUrl,
359:         sourceUrl: page.fullurl || null,
360:         title: page.title || null
361:     };
362: }

364: function fandomPageScore(page, wantedName) {
365:     const wanted = normalizeImageKey(wantedName);
366:     const title = normalizeImageKey(page?.title || '');
367:     if (!title) return -999;
368:     let score = 0;
369:     if (title === wanted) score += 100;
370:     if (title.includes(wanted) || wanted.includes(title)) score += 45;
371: 
372:     const wantedTokens = new Set(wanted.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
373:     const titleTokens = new Set(title.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
374:     let overlap = 0;
375:     wantedTokens.forEach(t => { if (titleTokens.has(t)) overlap++; });
376:     score += overlap * 8;
377: 
378:     if (/gallery|image gallery|images|list of|category|episode|chapter|volume/i.test(page?.title || '')) score -= 45;
379:     return score;
380: }

388:         pithumbsize: '700',

403: async function fetchFandomPageImageBySearch(host, name) {

405:         action: 'query',

407:         gsrsearch: name,
408:         gsrnamespace: '0',
409:         gsrlimit: '8',
410:         prop: 'pageimages|info',

412:         pithumbsize: '700',
413:         inprop: 'url',
414:         format: 'json',
415:         origin: '*'
416:     });
417:     const data = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(`https://${host}/api.php?${params}`, 12000);
418:     const pages = Object.values(data?.query?.pages || {})
419:         .filter(p => pageImageFromApiPage(p))
420:         .sort((a,b) => fandomPageScore(b, name) - fandomPageScore(a, name));
421: 
422:     return pages.length ? pageImageFromApiPage(pages[0]) : null;
423: }

445: async function fetchFandomTransformationPageFast(host, form) {
446:     const raw = String(form || '').trim();
447:     if (!raw) return null;
448:     const norm = normalizeImageKey(raw);
449:     const title = TRANSFORM_PAGE_ALIASES[norm] || raw;
450:     const params = new URLSearchParams({ action:'query', titles:title, prop:'pageimages|info', piprop:'original|thumbnail', pithumbsize:'900', inprop:'url', redirects:'1', format:'json', origin:'*' });
451:     try {
452:         const data = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(`https://${host}/api.php?${params}`, 3200);
453:         for (const page of Object.values(data?.query?.pages || {})) {
454:             if (page?.missing != null) continue;
455:             // La page elle-même doit correspondre à la forme. Jamais au personnage seul.
456:             const pt = normalizeImageKey(page.title || '');
457:             const wanted = normalizeImageKey(title);
458:             if (!(pt === wanted || pt.includes(wanted) || wanted.includes(pt))) continue;
459:             const hit = pageImageFromApiPage(page);
460:             if (hit?.imageUrl) return hit.imageUrl;
461:         }
462:     } catch (_) {}
463:     return null;
464: }

466: // Cherche une IMAGE de transformation dans les fichiers des pages Fandom, pas seulement
467: // l'image principale de la page personnage (qui est précisément la cause de "Sasuke normal").
468: async function fetchFandomTransformationImage(host, character, form) {
469:     const direct = await fetchFandomTransformationPageFast(host, form);
470:     if (direct) return direct;
471:     const stop = new Set(['mode','form','forme','anime','transformation','final','true','full','power','awakened','awakening']);
472:     const toks = x => normalizeImageKey(String(x||'')).split(' ').filter(t => t.length > 2 && !stop.has(t));
473:     const formTokens = toks(form), charTokens = toks(character);
474:     // Une image de transformation doit contenir des mots de LA FORME dans son nom de fichier.
475:     // Le nom du personnage seul n'est plus suffisant (cause d'Armin normal / Ichigo normal).
476:     const searches = [`${character} ${form}`, form].filter(Boolean);
477:     let files = [];
478:     for (const term of searches) {
479:         try {
480:             const sp = new URLSearchParams({action:'query',generator:'search',gsrsearch:term,gsrnamespace:'0',gsrlimit:'3',prop:'images',imlimit:'60',format:'json',origin:'*'});
481:             const d = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(`https://${host}/api.php?${sp}`, 3000);
482:             for (const pg of Object.values(d?.query?.pages||{})) for (const im of (pg.images||[])) if (im?.title) files.push(im.title);
483:         } catch (_) {}
484:     }
485:     files = [...new Set(files)].filter(t => /^File:/i.test(t) && !/logo|icon|symbol|map|volume|chapter|cover|game|card|render.*logo/i.test(t));
486:     const hits = title => {
487:         const n = normalizeImageKey(title.replace(/^File:/i,''));
488:         const fh = formTokens.filter(t => n.includes(t));
489:         const ch = charTokens.filter(t => n.includes(t));
490:         return { n, fh, ch };
491:     };
492:     const need = formTokens.length <= 1 ? 1 : Math.min(2, formTokens.length);
493:     // IMPORTANT: au moins 1/2 mots distinctifs de la forme, jamais juste le perso.
494:     files = files.filter(f => hits(f).fh.length >= need);
495:     const score = title => { const h=hits(title); return h.fh.length*20 + h.ch.length*4 + (/anime|episode|screenshot/.test(h.n)?2:0); };
496:     files.sort((a,b)=>score(b)-score(a));
497:     const best = files.slice(0,8);
498:     if (!best.length) return null;
499:     try {
500:         const qp = new URLSearchParams({action:'query',titles:best.join('|'),prop:'imageinfo',iiprop:'url|mime',iiurlwidth:'900',format:'json',origin:'*'});
501:         const d = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(`https://${host}/api.php?${qp}`, 3000);
502:         const pages = Object.values(d?.query?.pages||{}).sort((a,b)=>score(b.title)-score(a.title));
503:         for (const pg of pages) {
504:             const ii=pg.imageinfo?.[0]; const u=ii?.thumburl||ii?.url;
505:             if (u && /^https:/i.test(u) && /^image\//i.test(ii?.mime||'image/unknown')) return u;
506:         }
507:     } catch (_) {}
508:     return null;
509: }

519: const THEME_CHAR_IMAGES = (() => {
520:     const out = {};
521:     const add = (universeKey, name, img) => {
522:         if (!universeKey || !name || !img) return;
523:         const key = normalizeImageKey(cleanImageCharacterName(name));
524:         if (!key) return;
525:         out[universeKey] = out[universeKey] || {};
526:         if (!out[universeKey][key]) out[universeKey][key] = img;
527:     };
528:     for (const file of ['qap-themes.json', 'tierlist-themes.json']) {
529:         try {
530:             const themes = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, file), 'utf8')).themes || [];
531:             for (const theme of themes) {
532:                 if (theme.kind !== 'chars') continue;
533:                 for (const item of (theme.items || [])) {
534:                     const u = resolveImageUniverseKey(item.sub);
535:                     add(u, item.name, item.img);
536:                 }
537:             }
538:         } catch (_) {}
539:     }
540:     return out;
541: })();

570: function imageNameScore(wantedName, candidateNames) {
571:     const wanted = normalizeImageKey(wantedName);
572:     if (!wanted) return 0;
573:     let best = 0;
574:     const wt = new Set(wanted.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
575:     for (const raw of candidateNames.filter(Boolean)) {
576:         const n = normalizeImageKey(raw);
577:         if (!n) continue;
578:         if (n === wanted) best = Math.max(best, 100);
579:         else if (n.includes(wanted) || wanted.includes(n)) best = Math.max(best, 55);
580:         const nt = new Set(n.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
581:         let overlap = 0;
582:         wt.forEach(t => { if (nt.has(t)) overlap++; });
583:         best = Math.max(best, overlap * 18);
584:     }
585:     return best;
586: }

588: async function fetchAniListCharacterImage(universeKey, name) {
589:     const cacheKey = `${universeKey}|${normalizeImageKey(name)}`;
590:     if (CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) return CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
591: 
592:     const query = `query($s:String){Page(perPage:12){characters(search:$s,sort:FAVOURITES_DESC){
593:         id name{full native alternative} image{large}
594:         media(perPage:20,sort:POPULARITY_DESC){nodes{type title{romaji english native}}}
595:     }}}`;
596:     let hit = null;
597:     try {
598:         const r = await fetch('https://graphql.anilist.co', {
599:             method:'POST',
600:             headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json','User-Agent':'AnimeGame/1.0'},
601:             body:JSON.stringify({ query, variables:{ s:name } }),
602:             signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)
603:         });
604:         if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`AniList HTTP ${r.status}`);
605:         const d = await r.json();
606:         const chars = d?.data?.Page?.characters || [];
607:         const hints = IMAGE_ANILIST_MEDIA_HINTS[universeKey] || [];
608:         let mediaLabel = '';
609:         try { if (typeof ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME !== 'undefined') mediaLabel = ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[universeKey] || ''; } catch (_) {}
610:         let best = null, bestScore = -1;
611:         for (const c of chars) {
612:             if (!c?.image?.large || /default\.jpg$/i.test(c.image.large)) continue;
613:             const nScore = imageNameScore(name, [c.name?.full, c.name?.native, ...(c.name?.alternative || [])]);
614:             const titles = (c.media?.nodes || []).flatMap(m => [m?.title?.romaji, m?.title?.english, m?.title?.native]).filter(Boolean);
615:             const mediaOk = hints.length
616:                 ? titles.some(t => hints.some(rx => rx.test(t)))
617:                 : (!mediaLabel || titles.some(t => {
618:                     const a = normalizeImageKey(t), b = normalizeImageKey(mediaLabel);
619:                     return a === b || a.includes(b) || b.includes(a);
620:                 }));
621:             if (!mediaOk || nScore < 18) continue;
622:             const score = nScore + 120 + Math.min(20, titles.length);
623:             if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = c; }
624:         }
625:         if (best) hit = {
626:             imageUrl:best.image.large,
627:             sourceUrl:`https://anilist.co/character/${best.id}`,
628:             title:best.name?.full || name
629:         };
630:     } catch (_) {}
631:     CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.set(cacheKey, hit);
632:     if (CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.size > 4000) CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.delete(CHARACTER_ANILIST_CACHE.keys().next().value);
633:     return hit;
634: }

637: // CHARACTER IMAGE LOCAL VALIDATION V6
638: function characterLocalImageExistsV6(imageUrl) {
639:     const value = String(imageUrl || '');
640:     if (!/^\/assets\/images\//i.test(value)) return true;
641:     try {
642:         const fsV6 = require('fs');
643:         const pathV6 = require('path');
644:         const full = pathV6.join(__dirname, value.replace(/^\/+/, ''));
645:         const st = fsV6.statSync(full);
646:         return st.isFile() && st.size > 256;
647:     } catch (_) {
648:         return false;
649:     }
650: }

652: async function resolveCharacterImage(universeKey, displayName) {
653:         // CHARACTER IMAGE ADMIN V4
654:     // A URL selected by an admin is stored in Postgres and must survive Render redeploys.
655:     // Manual values deliberately take priority over bundled/static image maps and auto-resolvers.
656:     const manualName = cleanImageCharacterName(displayName);
657:     const manual = await getCachedCharacterImage(universeKey, manualName);
658:     if (manual?.imageUrl && manual?.sourceUrl === 'manual-admin') return manual;
659: 
660: const fixed = staticCharImage(universeKey, displayName);
661:     if (fixed && characterLocalImageExistsV6(fixed)) return { imageUrl:fixed, sourceUrl:null, status:'ok' };
662: 
663:     const host = FANDOM_WIKIS[universeKey] || null;
664:     // Un wiki Fandom n'est plus obligatoire : tous les nouveaux univers peuvent
665:     // tomber sur AniList. Cela évite que les cartes/personnages soient sans photo.
666:     if (!displayName) {
667:         return { imageUrl:null, sourceUrl:null, status:'missing' };
668:     }
669: 
670:     const cleanName = cleanImageCharacterName(displayName);
671:     const cacheKey = `${universeKey}|${normalizeImageKey(cleanName)}`;
672: 
673:     const cached = await getCachedCharacterImage(universeKey, cleanName);
674:     if (cached?.imageUrl) return cached;
675:     if (cached && !cached.imageUrl) {
676:         const retryAt = CHARACTER_IMAGE_RETRY_AT.get(cacheKey) || 0;
677:         if (Date.now() < retryAt) return cached;
678:         CHARACTER_IMAGE_RETRY_AT.set(cacheKey, Date.now() + 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
679:     }
680: 
681:     if (CHARACTER_IMAGE_INFLIGHT.has(cacheKey)) return CHARACTER_IMAGE_INFLIGHT.get(cacheKey);
682: 
683:     const task = (async () => {
684:         try {
685:             let searchName = cleanName;
686:             try {
687:                 const n = normalizeImageKey(cleanName);
688:                 const alias = typeof DLE_MASTER_ALIASES !== 'undefined' ? DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[universeKey]?.[n] : null;
689:                 if (alias && typeof DLE_MASTER_NAMES !== 'undefined') {
690:                     const found = (DLE_MASTER_NAMES[universeKey] || []).find(x => normalizeImageKey(x) === alias);
691:                     if (found) searchName = found;
692:                 }
693:             } catch (_) {}
694: 
695:             let hit = null;
696:             if (host) {
697:                 hit = await fetchFandomPageImageByExactTitle(host, searchName);
698:                 if (!hit) hit = await fetchFandomPageImageBySearch(host, searchName);
699:                 if (!hit && searchName !== cleanName) hit = await fetchFandomPageImageBySearch(host, cleanName);
700:             }
701:             if (!hit) hit = await fetchAniListCharacterImage(universeKey, searchName);
702:             if (!hit && searchName !== cleanName) hit = await fetchAniListCharacterImage(universeKey, cleanName);
703: 
704:             const result = hit
705:                 ? { imageUrl:hit.imageUrl, sourceUrl:hit.sourceUrl || null, status:'ok' }
706:                 : { imageUrl:null, sourceUrl:null, status:'missing' };
707: 
708:             await saveCachedCharacterImage(universeKey, cleanName, result);
709:             return result;
710:         } catch (e) {
711:             console.warn(`[Character image] ${universeKey}/${cleanName}:`, e.message);
712:             return { imageUrl:null, sourceUrl:null, status:'error' };
713:         } finally {
714:             CHARACTER_IMAGE_INFLIGHT.delete(cacheKey);
715:         }
716:     })();
717: 
718:     CHARACTER_IMAGE_INFLIGHT.set(cacheKey, task);
719:     return task;

11490: async function simplePool(items, n, fn) {
11491:     let cursor=0;
11492:     await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(n,Math.max(1,items.length))}, async()=>{
11493:         while (true) { const i=cursor++; if (i>=items.length) return; await fn(items[i],i); }
11494:     }));
11495: }

11565:                 if (img && await simpleStoreImage(x,img,best.url)) continue;
11566:             }
11567:             unresolved2.push(x);
11568:         }
11569:         await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));
11570:     }
11571: 
11572:     const unresolvedSearch=[];
11573:     await simplePool(unresolved2,3,async x=>{
11574:         const url=await simpleAniListCharacterSearch(x.u,x.name);
11575:         if (url) { const img=await simpleFetchImage(url); if (img && await simpleStoreImage(x,img,url)) return; }
11576:         unresolvedSearch.push(x);
11577:     });
11578: 
11579:     const unresolved3=[];
11580:     await simplePool(unresolvedSearch,4,async x=>{
11581:         const url=await simpleFandomUrl(x.u,x.name);
11582:         if (url) { const img=await simpleFetchImage(url); if (img && await simpleStoreImage(x,img,url)) return; }
11583:         unresolved3.push(x);
11584:     });
11585: 
11586:     const unresolved4=[];
11587:     for (const x of unresolved3) {
11588:         const url=await simpleJikanUrl(x.name,x.u);
11589:         if (url) { const img=await simpleFetchImage(url); if (img && await simpleStoreImage(x,img,url)) continue; }
11590:         unresolved4.push(x);
11591:     }
11592: 
11593:     const unresolved5=[];
11594:     for (const x of unresolved4) {
11595:         const url=await simpleWikipediaUrl(x.name,x.anime,x.u);
11596:         if (url) { const img=await simpleFetchImage(url); if (img && await simpleStoreImage(x,img,url)) continue; }
11597:         unresolved5.push(x);
11598:     }
11599: 
11600:     const after = await simpleExistingRows();
11601:     const finalMissing = chars.filter(x=>!after.get(`${x.u}|${normalizeImageKey(x.name)}`)?.has_bytes);
11602:     SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.stored = chars.length - finalMissing.length;
11603:     SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.missing = finalMissing.length;
11604:     SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.failed = finalMissing.slice(0,80).map(x=>({u:x.u,anime:x.anime,name:x.name}));
11605:     return finalMissing;
11606: }

11608: async function startSimpleImageMigration() {
11609:     if (SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.running) return;
11610:     SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.running=true; SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.startedAt=new Date().toISOString(); SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.lastError=null;
11611:     try {
11612:         await initDb();
11613:         await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE character_images ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS image_bytes BYTEA`);
11614:         await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE character_images ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mime_type TEXT`);
11615:         let missing=[];
11616:         for (let pass=1; pass<=3; pass++) {
11617:             missing=await simpleMigrationPass(pass);
11618:             if (!missing.length) break;
11619:             if (pass<3) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,12000));
11620:         }
11621:         SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.done = !missing.length;
11622:     } catch (e) {
11623:         SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.lastError=String(e?.stack || e?.message || e);
11624:         console.error('[Simple images] migration failed:',e);
11625:     } finally {
11626:         SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.running=false; SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.finishedAt=new Date().toISOString();
11627:         console.log('[Simple images] state',SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE);
11628:     }
11629: }

11640:         return res.send(row.image_bytes);
11641:     } catch (_) { return res.status(404).end(); }

11651: resolveCharacterImage = async function(universeKey,displayName){
11652:     const name=cleanImageCharacterName(displayName); const normName=normalizeImageKey(name);
11653:     try {
11654:         const r=await pool.query(`SELECT source_url,status,updated_at FROM character_images WHERE universe_key=$1 AND norm_name=$2 AND image_bytes IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(image_bytes)>=700 LIMIT 1`,[universeKey,normName]);
11655:         const row=r.rows[0];
11656:         if (row) return {imageUrl:simpleImageRoute(universeKey,name,new Date(row.updated_at).getTime()),sourceUrl:row.source_url||null,status:'ok'};
11657:     } catch (_) {}
11658:     if (!SIMPLE_IMAGE_STATE.done) return __legacyCharacterImageResolver(universeKey,displayName);
11659:     return {imageUrl:null,sourceUrl:null,status:'missing'};
11660: };

11681: /* ===== CORRECTIF ANTI-GEL (laisser tout en bas du fichier) ===== */
11682: // Remplace les versions lentes déclarées plus haut (la dernière déclaration gagne).
11683: 
11684: var __dleNames, __dleStatic;
11685: 
11686: function __dleIndex(u) {
11687:     if (!__dleNames) __dleNames = new Map();
11688:     const t = DLE_TARGET_NAMES[u] || [], m = DLE_MASTER_NAMES[u] || [];
11689:     const sig = t.length + '|' + m.length;
11690:     let idx = __dleNames.get(u);
11691:     if (idx && idx.sig === sig) return idx;
11692:     const al = DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[u] || {}, display = new Map();
11693:     for (const x of [...t, ...m]) {
11694:         const xn = normalizeDle(x), c = al[xn] || xn;
11695:         if (c && !display.has(c)) display.set(c, x);
11696:     }
11697:     idx = { sig, display };
11698:     __dleNames.set(u, idx);
11699:     return idx;
11700: }
11701: 
11702: function dleMasterCanonicalNorm(u, rawName) {
11703:     const n = normalizeDle(rawName);
11704:     if (!n) return null;
11705:     const c = (DLE_MASTER_ALIASES[u] || {})[n] || n;
11706:     return __dleIndex(u).display.has(c) ? c : null;
11707: }
11708: 
11709: function dleMasterDisplayName(u, canon) {
11710:     return __dleIndex(u).display.get(canon) || null;
11711: }
11712: 
11713: function dleProfileExists(u, raw) {
11714:     const c = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(u, raw);
11715:     if (!c) return false;
11716:     if (DLE_VERIFIED_PROFILES[u]?.has(c)) return true;
11717:     if (!__dleStatic) __dleStatic = new Map();
11718:     let set = __dleStatic.get(u);
11719:     if (!set) {
11720:         set = new Set();
11721:         const base = DLE_UNIVERSES[u];
11722:         const add = name => { const k = dleMasterCanonicalNorm(u, name); if (k) set.add(k); };
11723:         (base?.characters || []).forEach(ch => add(ch.name));
11724:         Object.keys(DLE_STATIC_PROFILES[u] || {}).forEach(name => add(name));
11725:         for (const [key, attrs] of Object.entries(DLE_MANUAL_OVERRIDES || {})) {
11726:             const [uk, n] = key.split('|');
11727:             if (uk === u && isCompleteDleAttrs(attrs, base?.categories)) add(n);
11728:         }
11729:         __dleStatic.set(u, set);
11730:     }
11731:     return set.has(c);
11732: }
11733: 
11734: async function enrichDleUniverse(u, { delayMs = 350 } = {}) {
11735:     if (u === 'pokemon') return; // Pokédex déjà complet, rien à chercher
11736:     DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.currentUniverse = u;
11737:     for (const [normName, displayName] of getDleMasterNames(u)) {
11738:         await new Promise(r => setImmediate(r)); // laisse le serveur répondre entre deux persos
11739:         if (dleProfileExists(u, normName)) continue;
11740:         DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.checked++;
11741:         try {
11742:             if (await enrichOneDleProfile(u, displayName)) DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.completed++;
11743:             else DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.skipped++;
11744:         } catch (e) {
11745:             DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.skipped++;
11746:             DLE_ENRICHMENT_STATE.lastError = e.message;
11747:         }
11748:         if (delayMs > 0) await sleepDle(delayMs);
11749:     }
11750: }

18103: /* ---------- collection de cartes ---------- */
18104: // Toutes les cartes d'un anime : d'abord les persos connus (ceux des mini-jeux), puis les autres persos de la base
18105: const CARD_POOL_CACHE = new Map();
18106: function cardPool(u) {
18107:     if (CARD_POOL_CACHE.has(u)) return CARD_POOL_CACHE.get(u);
18108:     const famous = arcFamous(u);
18109:     const out = famous.slice();
18110:     const seen = new Set(famous.map(c => normalizeRG(c.display)));
18111:     const src = ARC_FAMOUS_OVERRIDE[u] || (typeof DLE_TARGET_NAMES !== 'undefined' && DLE_TARGET_NAMES[u]) || [];
18112:     for (const raw of src) {
18113:         const display = arcDisplayName(u, raw);
18114:         const k = normalizeRG(display);
18115:         if (!k || seen.has(k)) continue;
18116:         seen.add(k);
18117:         out.push({ raw, display, extra: true });
18118:     }
18119:     out.famous = famous.length;
18120:     if (famous.length) CARD_POOL_CACHE.set(u, out);
18121:     return out;
18122: }
18123: // Rareté : persos connus = communes → légendaires / mythiques ; persos moins connus = rares → mythiques
18124: function cardRarityAt(u, idx) {
18125:     const list = cardPool(u), f = list.famous || list.length;
18126:     if (idx < f) return cardRarity(idx, f);
18127:     const e = (idx - f) / Math.max(1, list.length - f);
18128:     return e < 0.4 ? 'rare' : e < 0.75 ? 'epique' : e < 0.93 ? 'legendaire' : 'mythique';
18129: }
18130: // Raretés spéciales : versions à part des persos les plus iconiques, de plus en plus dures à avoir.
18131: // rate = chance par carte de booster ; top = combien de persos par anime ; animes = animes concernés (sinon tous)
18132: const SPECIAL_TIERS = [
18133:     { id: 'secrete', label: 'Secrète', top: 3, rate: 1 / 150, coins: 50 },
18134:     { id: 'divine', label: 'Divine', top: 2, rate: 1 / 600, coins: 150 },
18135:     { id: 'cosmique', label: 'Cosmique', top: 1, rate: 1 / 2500, coins: 400 },
18136:     { id: 'eternelle', label: 'Éternelle', top: 1, rate: 1 / 10000, coins: 1000, animes: ['naruto', 'onepiece', 'dragonball', 'bleach', 'snk', 'jojo', 'hxh', 'demonslayer', 'jjk', 'fma'] },
18137:     { id: 'omega', label: 'Oméga', top: 1, rate: 1 / 50000, coins: 3000, animes: ['onepiece', 'naruto', 'dragonball'] }
18138: ];
18139: const SPECIAL_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(SPECIAL_TIERS.map(t => [t.id, t]));
18140: const cardSpecialKey = (u, display, tier) => u + '|' + display + '|' + tier;
18141: // persos iconiques quand l'ordre de la liste ne suffit pas (Pokémon est rangé par numéro du Pokédex)
18142: const SPECIAL_ICONS = { pokemon: ['Pikachu', 'Dracaufeu', 'Mewtwo'] };
18143: function cardIcons(u) {
18144:     const want = SPECIAL_ICONS[u];
18145:     if (!want) return arcFamous(u);
18146:     const pool = cardPool(u);
18147:     return want.map(n => pool.find(c => c.display === n)).filter(Boolean);
18148: }
18149: function cardSpecials(tier, u) {
18150:     const t = SPECIAL_BY_ID[tier];
18151:     if (!t || (t.animes && !t.animes.includes(u))) return [];
18152:     return cardIcons(u).slice(0, t.top).map(c => ({ u, display: c.display, tier, key: cardSpecialKey(u, c.display, tier) }));
18153: }
18154: const cardSecretKey = (u, display) => cardSpecialKey(u, display, 'secrete');
18155: function cardSecrets(u) { return cardSpecials('secrete', u); }
18156: function cardAllSpecials(u) { return SPECIAL_TIERS.flatMap(t => cardSpecials(t.id, u)); }
18157: function cardResolve(u, name) {
18158:     if (!ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[u] || !name) return null;
18159:     const list = cardPool(u);
18160:     const n = normalizeRG(name);
18161:     let idx = list.findIndex(c => normalizeRG(c.display) === n);
18162:     if (idx < 0) idx = list.findIndex(c => normalizeRG(c.display).includes(n) || n.includes(normalizeRG(c.display)));
18163:     if (idx < 0) return null;
18164:     return { u, display: list[idx].display, idx, total: list.length, key: u + '|' + list[idx].display };
18165: }
18166: function cardRarity(idx, total) {
18167:     const f = idx / Math.max(1, total);
18168:     return f < 0.35 ? 'commune' : f < 0.65 ? 'rare' : f < 0.88 ? 'epique' : f < 0.97 ? 'legendaire' : 'mythique';
18169: }

18171:     if (HAS_DB) {
18172:         try { return new Map((await pool.query('SELECT ckey, n, shiny FROM cards WHERE user_id=$1', [uid])).rows.map(r => [r.ckey, { n: r.n, shiny: r.shiny }])); } catch (_) { return new Map(); }
18173:     }
18174:     if (!CARDS_MEM.has(uid)) CARDS_MEM.set(uid, new Map());

18177: async function cardGive(uid, c, shiny) {
18178:     let isNew = true;
18179:     if (HAS_DB) {
18180:         try {
18181:             const r = (await pool.query(`INSERT INTO cards (user_id, ckey, n, shiny) VALUES ($1,$2,1,$3)
18182:                 ON CONFLICT (user_id, ckey) DO UPDATE SET n = cards.n + 1, shiny = cards.shiny + $3 RETURNING n`, [uid, c.key, shiny ? 1 : 0])).rows[0];
18183:             isNew = !r || r.n === 1;
18184:         } catch (_) {}
18185:     } else {
18186:         const m = await cardsOf(uid);
18187:         const o = m.get(c.key);
18188:         if (o) { o.n++; o.shiny += shiny ? 1 : 0; isNew = false; } else m.set(c.key, { n: 1, shiny: shiny ? 1 : 0 });
18189:     }
18190:     return isNew;
18191: }
18192: const cardImg = c => '/api/avatar/img?u=' + encodeURIComponent(c.u) + '&n=' + encodeURIComponent(c.display);
18193: // Donne la carte d'un perso trouvé (brillante 1 fois sur 12). Doublon = quelques pièces.
18194: async function cardAward(p, u, name, opts) {
18195:     if (!p || !p.userId) return null;
18196:     const c = cardResolve(u, name);
18197:     if (!c) return null;
18198:     const shiny = Math.random() < ((opts && opts.shinyRate) || 1 / 12);
18199:     const isNew = await cardGive(p.userId, c, shiny);
18200:     const rarity = cardRarityAt(u, c.idx);
18201:     let coins = 0;
18202:     if (!isNew) { coins = (shiny ? 10 : 2) * ({ mythique: 3 }[rarity] || 1); await ecoAddCoins(p.userId, coins); }
18203:     const out = { name: c.display, anime: ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[u], u, rarity, shiny, isNew, coins, img: cardImg(c) };
18204:     if (!(opts && opts.silent)) io.to(p.id).emit('card_gain', out);
18205:     return out;
18206: }
18207: async function cardAwardSecret(uid, u, display, shiny, tier = 'secrete') {
18208:     const t = SPECIAL_BY_ID[tier] || SPECIAL_BY_ID.secrete;
18209:     const isNew = await cardGive(uid, { key: cardSpecialKey(u, display, t.id) }, !!shiny);
18210:     if (!isNew) await ecoAddCoins(uid, t.coins);
18211:     // Cosmique et au-dessus : annoncé à tout le serveur
18212:     if (['cosmique', 'eternelle', 'omega'].includes(t.id)) {
18213:         // (annonce à tout le serveur retirée) pseudoOf(uid).then(who => io.emit('rare_pull', { who, name: display, anime: ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[u], rarity: t.id, label: t.label, shiny: !!shiny })).catch(() => {});
18214:     }
18215:     return { name: display, anime: ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[u], u, rarity: t.id, shiny: !!shiny, isNew, coins: isNew ? 0 : t.coins, img: cardImg({ u, display }), secret: true };
18216: }
18217: function playerBySocket(sid) {
18218:     for (const r of Object.values(rooms)) { const p = r.players.find(x => x.id === sid); if (p) return { p, room: r }; }
18219:     return null;
18220: }
18221: // Mini-jeux : Pixel, Silhouette, Fusion, Colorie
18222: const _arcRevealCards = arcReveal;
18223: arcReveal = function (room, roomCode) {
18224:     try {
18225:         const g = arcGames[roomCode];
18226:         const cfg = g && ARC_GAMES[g.game];
18227:         if (g && cfg && g.phase === 'playing' && g.current) {
18228:             const ts = g.current.targets || [];
18229:             room.players.forEach(p => {
18230:                 if (!p.userId) return;
18231:                 const a = g.answers[p.id];
18232:                 if (cfg.answer === 'text' && a && a.correct && ts[0]) cardAward(p, ts[0].u, ts[0].display);
18233:                 else if (cfg.answer === 'multi') ((g.found || {})[p.id] || new Set()).forEach(i => { if (ts[i]) cardAward(p, ts[i].u, ts[i].display); });
18234:                 else if (cfg.answer === 'color' && a && a.pct >= 50 && ts[0]) cardAward(p, ts[0].u, ts[0].display);
18235:             });
18236:         }
18237:     } catch (e) { console.warn('[cartes]', e.message); }
18238:     return _arcRevealCards(room, roomCode);
18239: };
18240: // Dessine le perso : ceux qui ont trouvé
18241: const _drawRevealCards = drawReveal;
18242: drawReveal = function (room, roomCode) {
18243:     try {
18244:         const d = room.draw;
18245:         if (d && d.phase === 'drawing' && d.word) room.players.forEach(p => { if (d.guessed[pkeyOf(p)] != null) cardAward(p, d.word.u, d.word.display); });
18246:     } catch (_) {}
18247:     return _drawRevealCards(room, roomCode);
18248: };
18249: // Devine le perso : celui qui trouve
18250: const _guessRevealCards = guessReveal;
18251: guessReveal = function (room, roomCode, finder) {
18252:     try { const g = room.guess; if (finder && g && g.target && g.target.u) cardAward(finder, g.target.u, g.target.name); } catch (_) {}
18253:     return _guessRevealCards(room, roomCode, finder);
18254: };
18255: // Citations : le perso qui a dit la phrase
18256: const _quoteMatchCards = quoteAnswerMatches;
18257: quoteAnswerMatches = function (answerRaw, quote, universeKey) {
18258:     const ok = _quoteMatchCards(answerRaw, quote, universeKey);
18259:     if (ok && quote && CUR_SID) {
18260:         const f = playerBySocket(CUR_SID);
18261:         if (f) {
18262:             const keys = String(universeKey || '').split('+');
18263:             const u = keys.find(k => cardResolve(k, quote.speaker)) || keys[0];
18264:             cardAward(f.p, u, quote.speaker);
18265:         }
18266:     }
18267:     return ok;
18268: };
18269: // AnimeDLE : le perso mystère trouvé
18270: const _dleCompareCards = makeDleComparison;
18271: makeDleComparison = function (character, target, player, categories) {
18272:     const r = _dleCompareCards(character, target, player, categories);
18273:     try {
18274:         if (r && r.correct && player && player.userId) {
18275:             const f = playerBySocket(player.id);
18276:             const key = f && f.room.dle ? String(f.room.dle.universeKey || '') : '';
18277:             if (ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[key]) cardAward(player, key, target.name);
18278:         }
18279:     } catch (_) {}
18280:     return r;
18281: };
18282: const RAR_RANK = { commune: 0, rare: 1, epique: 2, legendaire: 3, mythique: 4, secrete: 5, divine: 6, cosmique: 7, eternelle: 8, omega: 9, halloween: 5 };
18283: // type : '' (normal), 'epique' (1 épique ou mieux garantie), 'mythique' (1 légendaire ou mieux garantie + secrètes x4)
18284: async function openBooster(uid, n, type = '') {
18285:     const us = arcUniverses();
18286:     const out = [];
18287:     const luck = await cardLuck(uid); // chance x2 (joueurs) / x10 (admins) activée dans le panneau admin
18288:     const mult = (type === 'mythique' ? 4 : type === 'epique' ? 2 : 1) * luck; // boosters spéciaux : raretés spéciales plus fréquentes
18289:     const minRank = type === 'mythique' ? 3 : type === 'epique' ? 2 : n >= 10 ? 1 : 0;
18290:     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
18291:         const u = us[Math.floor(Math.random() * us.length)];
18292:         let special = null;
18293:         for (const t of SPECIAL_TIERS.slice().reverse()) { // de la plus rare à la moins rare
18294:             if (Math.random() >= t.rate * mult) continue;
18295:             const us2 = t.animes ? t.animes.filter(x => ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[x]) : [u];
18296:             const cu = us2[Math.floor(Math.random() * us2.length)];
18297:             const sc = cardSpecials(t.id, cu);
18298:             if (sc.length) { special = sc[Math.floor(Math.random() * sc.length)]; break; }
18299:         }
18300:         if (special) { out.push(await cardAwardSecret(uid, special.u, special.display, Math.random() < Math.min(0.9, luck / 10), special.tier)); continue; }
18301:         const list = cardPool(u);
18302:         // les cartes connues tombent plus souvent, les rares moins (la chance rapproche des cartes rares)
18303:         let idx = Math.min(list.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.6 / Math.sqrt(luck)) * list.length));
18304:         const last = i === n - 1;
18305:         if (last && minRank && !out.some(c => (RAR_RANK[c.rarity] || 0) >= minRank)) {
18306:             const ok = list.map((c, j) => j).filter(j => RAR_RANK[cardRarityAt(u, j)] >= minRank);
18307:             if (ok.length) idx = ok[Math.floor(Math.random() * ok.length)];
18308:         }
18309:         const c = list[idx];
18310:         const r = await cardAward({ userId: uid, id: null }, u, c.display, { silent: true, shinyRate: 1 / 10 });
18311:         if (r) out.push(r);
18312:     }
18313:     return out;
18314: }

18437: const DAILY_GAMES = { dle: 'AnimeDLE', blindtest: 'Blind test', pixel: 'Pixel' };
18438: async function dailyScoreOf(uid, day, game) {
18439:     if (HAS_DB) { try { return (await pool.query('SELECT score, attempts FROM daily_results WHERE day=$1 AND game=$2 AND user_id=$3', [day, game, uid])).rows[0] || null; } catch (_) { return null; } }
18440:     const d = PROG_MEM.daily.find(x => x.day === day && x.game === game && x.user_id === uid);
18441:     return d ? { score: d.score, attempts: d.attempts } : null;
18442: }
18443: function challResult(game, a, b) { // a = celui qui défie, b = le défié
18444:     if (game === 'dle') { const x = a.attempts || 99, y = b.attempts || 99; return y < x ? 'win' : y > x ? 'lose' : 'draw'; }
18445:     return b.score > a.score ? 'win' : b.score < a.score ? 'lose' : 'draw';
18446: }
18447: async function challList(uid) {
18448:     if (HAS_DB) { try { return (await pool.query('SELECT * FROM challenges WHERE (from_id=$1 OR to_id=$1) AND created_at > now() - interval \'3 days\' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 40', [uid])).rows; } catch (_) { return []; } }
18449:     return CHALL_MEM.filter(c => c.from_id === uid || c.to_id === uid).slice(-40).reverse();
18450: }
18451: async function challResolve(c, mine) {
18452:     c.to_score = mine.score; c.to_attempts = mine.attempts; c.result = challResult(c.game, c, mine);
18453:     if (HAS_DB) { try { await pool.query('UPDATE challenges SET to_score=$2, to_attempts=$3, result=$4 WHERE id=$1', [c.id, c.to_score, c.to_attempts, c.result]); } catch (_) {} }
18454:     const txt = c.result === 'win' ? `${c.to_pseudo} a battu ton score au ${DAILY_GAMES[c.game]} du jour !` : c.result === 'lose' ? `${c.to_pseudo} n’a pas réussi à battre ton score au ${DAILY_GAMES[c.game]} du jour 💪` : `Égalité avec ${c.to_pseudo} au ${DAILY_GAMES[c.game]} du jour !`;
18455:     socketsOfUser(c.from_id).forEach(sid => io.to(sid).emit('challenge_update', { text: txt, result: c.result }));
18456:     if (c.result === 'win') await ecoAddCoins(c.to_id, 30);
18457: }

18490: const _dailyRecordChall = dailyRecord;
18491: dailyRecord = async function (game, players, scoreOf) {
18492:     const r = await _dailyRecordChall(game, players, scoreOf);
18493:     const day = dailyKey();
18494:     for (const p of players) {
18495:         if (!p.userId) continue;
18496:         const mine = await dailyScoreOf(p.userId, day, game);
18497:         if (!mine) continue;
18498:         const open = HAS_DB ? await pool.query('SELECT * FROM challenges WHERE to_id=$1 AND day=$2 AND game=$3 AND result IS NULL', [p.userId, day, game]).then(x => x.rows).catch(() => [])
18499:             : CHALL_MEM.filter(c => c.to_id === p.userId && c.day === day && c.game === game && !c.result);
18500:         for (const c of open) await challResolve(c, mine);
18501:         if (open.length) io.to(p.id).emit('challenge_update', { text: open.map(c => challResult(c.game, c, mine) === 'win' ? `✅ Défi de ${c.from_pseudo} battu ! +30 pièces` : `❌ Tu n’as pas battu ${c.from_pseudo}`).join(' • ') });
18502:     }
18503:     return r;
18504: };

18632: /* =====================================================================
18633:    HUB : Zoom extrême, duel classé, clans, salon vocal, mode spectateur,
18634:    pass de saison, échange et fusion de cartes, coffre du jour, maîtrise
18635:    des animes, week-end x2, boss du serveur, anime de la semaine,
18636:    tournoi du dimanche
18637:    ===================================================================== */
18638: const HUB_SHIFT = +(process.env.HUB_TIME_SHIFT_MS || 0); // pour tester les horaires
18639: const hubNow = () => Date.now() + HUB_SHIFT;
18640: function parisParts(ms = hubNow()) {
18641:     const o = {};
18642:     new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/Paris', weekday: 'short', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' })
18643:         .formatToParts(new Date(ms)).forEach(p => { o[p.type] = p.value; });
18644:     return { wd: o.weekday, y: +o.year, m: +o.month, d: +o.day, h: +o.hour, min: +o.minute };
18645: }
18646: function isWeekend(ms) { const w = parisParts(ms).wd; return w === 'Sat' || w === 'Sun'; }
18647: function hubMult() { return isWeekend() ? 2 : 1; }
18648: function weekKey(ms = hubNow()) { // lundi de la semaine (heure de Paris)
18649:     const p = parisParts(ms);
18650:     const d = new Date(Date.UTC(p.y, p.m - 1, p.d));
18651:     d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - ((d.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7));
18652:     return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
18653: }
18654: function seasonKey(ms = hubNow()) { const p = parisParts(ms); return p.y + '-' + String(p.m).padStart(2, '0'); }
18655: function seasonEndsAt(ms = hubNow()) { // approximatif : 1er du mois suivant à minuit (Paris ≈ UTC+1/2)
18656:     const p = parisParts(ms);
18657:     return Date.UTC(p.m === 12 ? p.y + 1 : p.y, p.m === 12 ? 0 : p.m, 1) - 3600 * 1000;
18658: }
18659: function hubHash(s) { let h = 2166136261; for (const c of String(s)) { h ^= c.charCodeAt(0); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return h >>> 0; }

18661: /* ---------- petit stockage clé / valeur (table hub_kv, cache mémoire) ---------- */
18662: const KV = new Map();
18663: const KV_READY = HAS_DB
18664:     ? pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hub_kv (ns TEXT NOT NULL, k TEXT NOT NULL, v JSONB, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (ns, k))`).catch(e => console.warn('[Hub] table :', e.message))
18665:     : Promise.resolve();
18666: const kvClone = v => v === undefined ? null : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
18667: async function kvGet(ns, k, def) {
18668:     const key = ns + '|' + k;
18669:     if (KV.has(key)) return KV.get(key);
18670:     let v;
18671:     if (HAS_DB) {
18672:         await KV_READY;
18673:         try { const r = (await pool.query('SELECT v FROM hub_kv WHERE ns=$1 AND k=$2', [ns, String(k)])).rows[0]; if (r) v = r.v; } catch (_) {}
18674:     }
18675:     if (KV.has(key)) return KV.get(key); // chargé entre-temps par un autre appel
18676:     if (v === undefined || v === null) v = def === undefined ? null : kvClone(def);
18677:     KV.set(key, v);
18678:     return v;
18679: }
18680: async function kvSet(ns, k, v) {
18681:     KV.set(ns + '|' + k, v);
18682:     if (!HAS_DB) return;
18683:     await KV_READY;
18684:     try { await pool.query('INSERT INTO hub_kv (ns, k, v, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,now()) ON CONFLICT (ns, k) DO UPDATE SET v=$3, updated_at=now()', [ns, String(k), JSON.stringify(v)]); }
18685:     catch (e) { console.warn('[Hub] kvSet', ns, e.message); }
18686: }
18687: async function kvDel(ns, k) {
18688:     KV.delete(ns + '|' + k);
18689:     if (HAS_DB) { await KV_READY; try { await pool.query('DELETE FROM hub_kv WHERE ns=$1 AND k=$2', [ns, String(k)]); } catch (_) {} }
18690: }
18691: async function kvList(ns) { // [{k, v}]
18692:     const out = new Map();
18693:     if (HAS_DB) {
18694:         await KV_READY;
18695:         try { (await pool.query('SELECT k, v FROM hub_kv WHERE ns=$1', [ns])).rows.forEach(r => { if (!KV.has(ns + '|' + r.k)) KV.set(ns + '|' + r.k, r.v); }); } catch (_) {}
18696:     }
18697:     for (const [key, v] of KV) if (key.startsWith(ns + '|') && v !== null) out.set(key.slice(ns.length + 1), v);
18698:     return [...out].map(([k, v]) => ({ k, v }));
18699: }

18816:         if (tier === PASS_TIERS) return { booster: 10, label: 'Booster 10 cartes' };
18817:         if (tier % 5 === 0) return { booster: 3, label: 'Booster 3 cartes' };
18818:         return { coins: 20 + tier * 2, label: `${20 + tier * 2} pièces` };
18819:     }
18820:     if (tier === 10) return { item: 'color:aurora', label: 'Couleur Aurore 🌌' };
18821:     if (tier === 20) return { item: 'frame:flame', label: 'Cadre Flammes 🔥' };
18822:     if (tier === 25) return { item: 'effect:aurora', label: 'Effet Aurore boréale' };
18823:     if (tier === PASS_TIERS) return { item: 'title:legende', label: 'Titre « Légende de la saison »', coins: 300 };
18824:     if (tier % 5 === 0) return { booster: 10, label: 'Booster 10 cartes' };
18825:     return { coins: 40 + tier * 3, label: `${40 + tier * 3} pièces` };
18826: }
18827: async function passGet(uid, season = seasonKey()) { return kvGet('pass', season + '|' + uid, { xp: 0, premium: false, free: [], prem: [] }); }
18828: async function passAddXp(uid, xp, sid) {
18829:     const season = seasonKey();
18830:     const p = await passGet(uid, season);
18831:     const before = Math.min(PASS_TIERS, Math.floor(p.xp / PASS_XP));
18832:     p.xp += Math.max(0, Math.round(xp));
18833:     const after = Math.min(PASS_TIERS, Math.floor(p.xp / PASS_XP));
18834:     await kvSet('pass', season + '|' + uid, p);
18835:     if (after > before) (sid ? io.to(sid) : { emit() {} }).emit('pass_tier', { tier: after });
18836: }

18840:     if (rw.booster) out.cards = await openBooster(uid, rw.booster);
18841:     if (rw.item) { await ownAdd(uid, rw.item); out.item = rw.item; }
18842:     return out;
18843: }

18883: const CHEST_COINS = [30, 40, 50, 60, 80, 100, 150];
18884: async function chestInfo(uid) {
18885:     const c = await kvGet('chest', uid, { day: null, streak: 0 });
18886:     const today = dailyKey(new Date(hubNow())), yest = dailyKey(new Date(hubNow() - 86400000));
18887:     const ready = c.day !== today;
18888:     const streakNext = c.day === yest ? c.streak + 1 : (c.day === today ? c.streak : 1);
18889:     return { c, today, ready, streak: c.day === today || c.day === yest ? c.streak : 0, dayNext: ((streakNext - 1) % 7) + 1 };
18890: }

18900:     const yest = dailyKey(new Date(hubNow() - 86400000));
18901:     i.c.streak = i.c.day === yest ? i.c.streak + 1 : 1;
18902:     i.c.day = i.today;

18904:     const d = ((i.c.streak - 1) % 7);

18931: async function cardTake(uid, key, count = 1) { // retire des exemplaires ; renvoie {shiny} ou null
18932:     if (HAS_DB) {
18933:         const row = (await pool.query('SELECT n, shiny FROM cards WHERE user_id=$1 AND ckey=$2', [uid, key])).rows[0];
18934:         if (!row || row.n < count) return null;
18935:         const left = row.n - count, shinyMove = left === 0 && row.shiny > 0;
18936:         if (left === 0) await pool.query('DELETE FROM cards WHERE user_id=$1 AND ckey=$2', [uid, key]);
18937:         else await pool.query('UPDATE cards SET n=$3, shiny=LEAST(shiny, $3) WHERE user_id=$1 AND ckey=$2', [uid, key, left]);
18938:         return { shiny: shinyMove };
18939:     }
18940:     const m = await cardsOf(uid), o = m.get(key);
18941:     if (!o || o.n < count) return null;
18942:     const left = o.n - count, shinyMove = left === 0 && o.shiny > 0;
18943:     if (left === 0) m.delete(key); else { o.n = left; o.shiny = Math.min(o.shiny, left); }
18944:     return { shiny: shinyMove };
18945: }

18953:     }
18954:     return null;
18955: }

19073: async function cardListOf(uid) {
19074:     const mine = await cardsOf(uid), fin = await kvGet('fin', String(uid), {});
19075:     const out = [];
19076:     mine.forEach((v, k) => {
19077:         const info = cardInfoOfKey(k); if (!info || !(v.n > 0)) return;
19078:         const e = fin[k] || {}; let left = v.n;
19079:         FIN_IDS.forEach(f => {
19080:             const c = Math.min(e[f] || 0, left); if (c <= 0) return;
19081:             left -= c;
19082:             out.push({ ...info, key: k, finish: f, n: c, shiny: v.shiny, serial: e.ser && e.ser[f] && e.ser[f].length ? Math.min(...e.ser[f]) : null });
19083:         });
19084:         if (left > 0) out.push({ ...info, key: k, finish: null, n: left, shiny: v.shiny });
19085:     });
19086:     return out.sort((a, b) => a.anime.localeCompare(b.anime, 'fr') || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'fr'));

19090: async function finMove(from, to, key, f) {

19092:     if (!ea || !ea[f]) return;
19093:     ea[f]--; let ser = null;
19094:     if (ea.ser && ea.ser[f] && ea.ser[f].length) ser = ea.ser[f].shift();
19095:     await kvSet('fin', String(from), a);
19096:     const b = await kvGet('fin', String(to), {}), eb = b[key] = b[key] || {};
19097:     eb[f] = (eb[f] || 0) + 1;
19098:     if (ser != null) { eb.ser = eb.ser || {}; (eb.ser[f] = eb.ser[f] || []).push(ser); }
19099:     await kvSet('fin', String(to), b);
19100: }

22494: /* =====================================================================

22497:    Légende vivante, cartes Duo, cartes de saison (Noël, Saint-Valentin,
22498:    Été), God Pack, répliques cultes, amélioration de finition, vitrine,
22499:    compteur mondial et cadre « Album complet ».

22516:     { id: 'glitch', label: 'Glitch', rate: 1 / 500 }, { id: 'galaxy', label: 'Galaxie', rate: 1 / 400 },
22517:     { id: 'manga', label: 'Manga', rate: 1 / 300 }, { id: 'fullart', label: 'Full Art', rate: 1 / 250 },
22518:     { id: 'dark', label: 'Dark', rate: 1 / 200 }, { id: 'gold', label: 'Gold', rate: 1 / 150 },
22519:     { id: 'glitter', label: 'Pailletée', rate: 1 / 40 }, { id: 'reverse', label: 'Reverse Holo', rate: 1 / 30 },
22520:     { id: 'holo', label: 'Holographique', rate: 1 / 20 }
22521: ];
22522: const FIN_IDS = FINISHES.map(f => f.id); // index 0 = la plus prestigieuse
22523: const NUMBERED_MAX = 50; // tirage limité : 50 exemplaires de chaque carte numérotée sur tout le serveur
22524: const finBetter = (a, b) => !b ? a : !a ? b : FIN_IDS.indexOf(a) <= FIN_IDS.indexOf(b) ? a : b;
22525: function rollFinish(luck) {

22527:     return null;

22529: async function finAdd(uid, key, fid) {
22530:     const g = await kvGet('fincount', key, {});
22531:     if (fid === 'numbered' && (g.numbered || 0) >= NUMBERED_MAX) fid = 'signed';
22532:     g[fid] = (g[fid] || 0) + 1;
22533:     kvSet('fincount', key, g); // gardé en mémoire tout de suite, écrit en base sans bloquer l'ouverture
22534:     const m = await kvGet('fin', String(uid), {});
22535:     const e = m[key] = m[key] || {};
22536:     e[fid] = (e[fid] || 0) + 1;
22537:     let serial = null;
22538:     if (fid === 'numbered' || fid === 'signed') { serial = g[fid]; e.ser = e.ser || {}; (e.ser[fid] = e.ser[fid] || []).push(serial); }
22539:     kvSet('fin', String(uid), m);
22540:     return { finish: fid, serial, serialMax: fid === 'numbered' ? NUMBERED_MAX : null, finCount: g[fid] };
22541: }
22542: const finBestOf = e => e ? FIN_IDS.find(f => e[f] > 0) || null : null;

22545: // --- répliques cultes (tirées des citations du mode Citations) ---
22546: let QUOTE_IDX = null;
22547: function cardQuote(u, name) {

22553:             }));
22554:         } catch (_) {}
22555:     }
22556:     const n = normalizeRG(name);
22557:     const list = QUOTE_IDX.get(u + '|' + n) || QUOTE_IDX.get(u + '|' + n.split(' ')[0]);
22558:     return list && list.length ? list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] : null;
22559: }
22560: async function cardDecorate(uid, card, luck) {

22562:     const fid = rollFinish(luck);
22563:     if (fid) Object.assign(card, await finAdd(uid, cardKeyOf(card), fid));
22564:     const r = RAR_RANK[card.rarity] || 0;
22565:     if (r >= 3 || card.finish === 'signed' || card.finish === 'numbered') { const q = cardQuote(card.u, card.name); if (q) card.quote = q; }
22566:     return card;

22663:         if (seasons.length && Math.random() < Math.min(0.3, (1 / 150) * luck)) {

22867: function partyMixParse(raw) {

22870:     const body = s.slice('partymix:'.length);

22873:     const valid = games.length >= 3 ? games : PARTY_MIX_FALLBACK.slice();
22874:     const per = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Number(perRaw) || 2));
22875:     return { games: valid, per };

23640: let ORDER_POOL_CACHE=null;
23641: function orderPools(){
23642:     if(ORDER_POOL_CACHE)return ORDER_POOL_CACHE;
23643:     const out=[];
23644:     for(const u of arcUniverses()){
23645:         let d=null; try{d=dleExpandedUniverse(u);}catch(_){continue;}
23646:         for(const cat of (d?.categories||[])){
23647:             const vals=[];
23648:             for(const c of d.characters||[]){ const n=dleNumberValue(c.attrs?.[cat.key]); if(n!==null&&Number.isFinite(n)) vals.push({u,name:c.name,value:n}); }
23649:             const unique=[]; const seenV=new Set();
23650:             for(const x of arcShuffle(vals)){ if(seenV.has(x.value))continue; seenV.add(x.value); unique.push(x); }
23651:             if(unique.length>=5) out.push({u,anime:d.name||ARC_UNIVERSE_ANIME[u]||u,key:cat.key,label:cat.label,items:unique});
23652:         }
23653:     }
23654:     ORDER_POOL_CACHE=out; return out;
23655: }
23656: function orderBuildRound(g){
23657:     let pools=orderPools().filter(p=>!g.used.has('ord|'+p.u+'|'+p.key));
23658:     if(!pools.length){ for(const k of [...g.used])if(k.startsWith('ord|'))g.used.delete(k); pools=orderPools(); }
23659:     const p=arcPick(pools); if(!p)return null; g.used.add('ord|'+p.u+'|'+p.key);
23660:     const chosen=arcShuffle(p.items).slice(0,5).sort((a,b)=>a.value-b.value);
23661:     const shuffled=arcShuffle(chosen.map((x,i)=>({id:'o'+i+'_'+hubHash(x.u+'|'+x.name+'|'+x.value),name:x.name,value:x.value})));
23662:     const correct=chosen.map(x=>shuffled.find(y=>y.name===x.name)?.id).filter(Boolean);
23663:     return {u:p.u,orderPrompt:`${p.anime} • ${p.label} : du plus petit au plus grand`,orderItems:shuffled.map(({id,name})=>({id,name})),orderCorrect:correct,answer:chosen.map(x=>`${x.name} (${x.value})`).join(' → ')};
23664: }
23665: function orderScore(submitted,correct){
23666:     if(!Array.isArray(submitted)||submitted.length!==correct.length||new Set(submitted).size!==correct.length)return 0;
23667:     let pairs=0,total=0; const pos=Object.fromEntries(submitted.map((id,i)=>[id,i]));
23668:     for(let i=0;i<correct.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<correct.length;j++){total++;if(pos[correct[i]]<pos[correct[j]])pairs++;}
23669:     return pairs===total?150:Math.round(100*pairs/Math.max(1,total));
23670: }

23672: const GRID_TRAITS=['fire','lightning','water','sword','magic','eye','transform','villain','leader','royal','demon','pirate','ninja','hunter','shinigami','ghoul','titan'];
23673: function gridBuildPuzzle(){
23674:     const cat=bingoCatalog(); const byU={}; for(const c of cat)(byU[c.u]||(byU[c.u]=[])).push(c);
23675:     const universes=Object.keys(byU).filter(u=>byU[u].length>=12);
23676:     for(let tries=0;tries<500;tries++){
23677:         const rows=arcShuffle(universes).slice(0,3); if(rows.length<3)break;
23678:         const possible=GRID_TRAITS.filter(t=>rows.every(u=>byU[u].filter(c=>(c.tags||[]).includes(t)).length>=1));
23679:         if(possible.length<3)continue;
23680:         const cols=arcShuffle(possible).slice(0,3); const candidates={}; let ok=true;
23681:         rows.forEach((u,r)=>cols.forEach((t,c)=>{const k=r+'|'+c;candidates[k]=byU[u].filter(x=>(x.tags||[]).includes(t));if(!candidates[k].length)ok=false;}));
23682:         if(ok)return {rows,cols,candidates};
23683:     }
23684:     return null;
23685: }

23812:     }else{
23813:         const since=Date.now()-366*86400000,agg={};for(const r of PROG_MEM.results.filter(x=>x.created_at>=since)){const d=new Date(r.created_at),season=`${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`,k=[season,r.mode,r.user_id].join('|'),o=agg[k]||(agg[k]={season,mode:r.mode,user_id:r.user_id,pseudo:r.pseudo,points:0,games:0,wins:0});o.points+=r.points||0;o.games++;o.wins+=r.won?1:0;}raw=Object.values(agg);
23814:     }

23817:     const out=Object.values(seasons).sort((a,b)=>b.season.localeCompare(a.season)).map(s=>({season:s.season,champion:best(s.global),modes:Object.entries(s.modes).map(([mode,list])=>({mode,label:MODE_LABELS[mode]||mode,winner:best(list)})).filter(x=>x.winner).sort((a,b)=>b.winner.wins-a.winner.wins||b.winner.points-a.winner.points).slice(0,10)}));

23822: /* =====================================================================
23823:    CARTES ALT ART + MOMENT
23824:    - Alt Art : version alternative d'un héros, illustrée par une scène culte
23825:    - Moment : carte de scène culte (miniature de la scène déjà utilisée par Scene Guessr)
23826:    Ces cartes sont des bonus de booster : elles n'enlèvent aucune carte du pack.
23827:    ===================================================================== */
23828: const ALT_ART_RATE = 1 / 220;
23829: const MOMENT_CARD_RATE = 1 / 360;
